title: Lift Ka Darwaza Aapko Kaise Rokta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Lift ka darwaza aapko bina chhue kaise rok deta hai? Jaadu nahi, infrared ka khel hai!
🚪 Myth: darwaza touch se feel karta hai, sach kuch aur hai
💡 Andar IR LED aur photodiode ki kataar kaise kaam karti hai
⚡ Beam kat'ti hai to controller motor ko kaise ulta chalata hai
🛠️ Ek practical tip jo har lift user ko pata honi chahiye
Aise aur videos ke liye subscribe karein!
